earnings.title: 303-460-3537, ascott@ball.com
highlights: GAAP total diluted loss per share of 36 cents vs. earnings per share of $1.18 in 2025
Third quarter comparable diluted earnings per share of $1.10 vs. $1.03 in 2025, an increase of 6.8%
Third quarter comparable operating earnings of $451 million vs. $440 million in 2025, an increase of 2.5%

Returned $431 million to shareholders via share repurchases and dividends in the first nine months of 2026; on track to return at least $800 million through share buybacks and dividends to shareholders by year-end
Ball’s third quarter 2026 comparable net earnings were $293 million, or $1.10 per diluted share compared to $280 million, or $1.03 per diluted share in 2025.

quotes.text: Ball delivered another quarter of strong results, reflecting the power of our customer-focused strategy, disciplined execution and the ownership mindset embedded throughout our organization.

Our third quarter results reflect disciplined execution across the business, supported by global volume growth, operational performance and the stability provided by our contractual passthrough mechanisms.
quotes.by: Dan Rabbitt, senior vice president and chief financial officer

outlook: In 2026, expect comparable diluted earnings per share growth of 10-plus percent and free cash flow in the range of $900 million
